title: Nokia Morph Concept (long)
summary: A concept video from Nokia Research Center and Cambridge Nanoscience Center showing Morph, a flexible, self-cleaning, shape-changing phone imagined through nanotechnology.
why: HN brings it up as a nostalgic, exciting concept in threads on foldable phones and design, and sometimes as an example of concept videos that never shipped.

quote.text: I have just watched the video about it [2] again and I am still as excited about it as I was 11 years ago.
